name: SEO Content Optimizer
headline: SEO Content Optimizer: Keyword & Readability
short_description: An npm package that analyzes content for SEO optimization by calculating keyword density and readability scores using Flesch-Kincaid and ARI algorithms.
author: brandonhimpfen

sections.overview:
The SEO Content Optimizer is an npm package designed to help content creators and marketers improve their search engine rankings through data-driven analysis. It calculates keyword density—the percentage of target keywords relative to total word count—and generates readability scores using established algorithms like Flesch-Kincaid and Automated Readability Index (ARI). By providing concrete metrics on keyword usage and content readability, this tool helps optimize content for both search engines and user engagement. Developers and content strategists can integrate these functions into their workflows to ensure proper keyword distribution while maintaining readable, accessible content.
Analyzing blog posts for optimal keyword density before publishing
Evaluating readability levels of web content for target audiences
Auditing multiple articles to ensure consistent SEO optimization standards
Automating content quality checks in editorial workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/brandonhimpfen/seo-content-optimizer`
sections.usage:
```
Optimize this content for SEO targeting [KEYWORD] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The content is about [TOPIC]. Ensure it includes relevant keywords, meta descriptions, and headers. Also, suggest internal links to [RELATED_TOPICS].
```
Copy

```
# SEO-Optimized Content for [KEYWORD] in [INDUSTRY] Sector
```
